gaps.lead: Nobody else in the team runs as fast as Maya.
gaps.explanation: nobody runs faster = she is the fastest runner.

gaps.lead: That's the school where my mother teaches.
gaps.explanation: where = in which in formal relative clauses.

gaps.lead: A professional will repair the roof next week.
gaps.explanation: 'Have something done' — arranged service: have the roof repaired.

gaps.lead: His trainers were so worn out that they had holes in them.
gaps.sentence: His trainers were ___ they had holes in them.
gaps.explanation: so worn out = in such bad condition.

gaps.lead: They say the new tunnel will halve journey times.
gaps.sentence: Journey times ___ by the new tunnel.
gaps.explanation: X is said to be + participle: reported statement, passive meaning.

gaps.lead: This is the best coffee I've ever tasted.
gaps.explanation: 'The best I've ever tasted' → 'never tasted better'.
